title: Central Bank of Belize (Amendment) Act No. 15 of 2025

Central Bank of Belize
BELIZE:
CENTRAL BANK OF BELIZE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2025
ARRANGEMENT OF SECTIONS
1. Short title.
2. Amendment of section 2.
3. Amendment of section 11.

No. 15] Central Bank of Belize 565
No. 15 of 2025
I assent,
Dame Froyla Tzalam
Deputy Governor-General
25th July, 2025.
AN ACT to amend the Central Bank of Belize Act,
Chapter 262 of the Substantive Laws of Belize, Revised
Edition 2020; to provide for the Director General of
the Financial Services Commission to be a member of
the Board of Directors of the Central Bank of Belize;
and to provide for matters connected therewith or
incidental thereto.
(Gazetted 2nd August, 2025)
BE IT ENACTED, by and with the advice and consent of
the House of Representatives and Senate of Belize and
by the authority of the same, as follows:
